project_type: Single-file HTML page with inline CSS and JavaScript
test_framework: None - manual validation against sample data
test_command: N/A (validate calculator output against known sample data)
verification_instructions: Open index.html in browser and verify calculations match sample data
setup_instructions: No setup required - single HTML file
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. Cannot extract full rate tables from Excel files (only individual proposals available). Must use sample data to derive rates and interpolate.
contribution_requirements: All changes go in index.html. Calculator must work entirely client-side with embedded data.
key_patterns: Single-file HTML app with inline styles and scripts. Uses IIFE pattern for calculator JS. CSS uses .calc-controls, .result-card, .calc-control-group patterns. Tab-based navigation. Green theme (#00a758).
directory_structure: Single HTML file (index.html) plus source Excel/PDF files for reference data. Project root contains proposal files and training materials.

rate_data.description: Premium rates derived from user-provided sample data. All rates are for Band 2 (IDR 100jt Dana Mapan). Rates represent annual premium per unit Dana Mapan.

validation_scenarios.description: Pria 45, IDR, UM55, Tahunan, Premi 50jt -> DM 56,296,800
